title: ever EDEN|Flowy Chiffon Round Neckline A-Line Knee Length Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elegance meets charm in our Flowy Chiffon Round Neckline A-Line Knee-Length Wedding Guest Dress. Crafted with care, this dress boasts a timeless A-line silhouette and a graceful round neckline. The flowy chiffon fabric adds a touch of ethereal beauty, making it the perfect choice for wedding guests. Dance the night away in this knee-length masterpiece that effortlessly combines comfort and style.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Knee length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
